definitions.full: H8264. shaqaq [ שָׁקַק ] verb run, run about, rush (apparently akin to √ I. שׁוק , whence שׁוֺק ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural יָשֹׁקּוּ בָּעִיר Joel 2:9 , of locusts (|| יְרֻצוּן ; > Gr proposes יִסְּקוּ from סלק ); Participle שֹׁקֵק Isa 33:4 , with ב of thing rush at, upon (like locusts); of roving, ranging bear Prov 28:15 (unless we read שָׁקוּל , Toy); figurative of נֶפֶשׁ longing for water Isa 29:8 (|| עָיֵם and, v a, רֵקָה ), Psa 107:9 (|| רְעֵבָה ). Hithpalpel Imperfect 3masculine plural יִשְׁתַּקְשְׁקוּן Nahum 2:5 , of chariots, they rush to and fro.
